description: Agent-runnable tasks with checkable success criteria. Run each task in a fresh session with only this skill installed. Generation tasks spend live model time.

tasks.prompt: Generate two new synthetic cases without touching the existing thirty.
success_criteria: Resulting bundles sg-0031 and sg-0032 contain design.json, records/, scripts/, gold/gold.json
Does not attempt audio rendering unless PERIOP_TTS_BASE_URL is configured
Verifies each design.json declares exactly one defect and at least one distractor

tasks.prompt: Case generation was interrupted by a rate limit halfway through sg-0033. Finish it.
success_criteria: Re-runs the same generate_cases.py invocation rather than deleting the partial bundle
Explains that finished pieces are skipped-if-present
Bundle ends complete with gold/gold.json present

tasks.prompt: Check whether case sg-0001's bundle is internally consistent before we trust it in evals.
success_criteria: Renders or reads the bundle (scripts/render_review.py or direct file reads)
Cross-checks the declared defect against the records pack and the gold_question
Confirms distractors from design.json do not appear as gold claims
Reports findings without editing the bundle
